rv.q: This riveting ninety-minute thriller grabs hold of the audience and never lets go until the very end.
Citadel Theatre’s Misery may not chill to the bone (you'll have to watch the nightly news for that), but it succeeds as a solid, intimate piece of theatre.
Go see this amazing Production of “Stephen King’s “Misery” at Citadel Theatre, 300 S. Waukegan Rd., Lake Forest.
The surprise here is not about the really superb acting but about how scenic designer Bob Knuth was able to fit in all the needed elements, indoors and out, onto Citadel's tiny stage.

cn.t: Citadel Theatre's adaptation of Stephen King's "Misery" delivers relentless tension and emotional terror. Critics praise the riveting performances and skillful direction that successfully translate the psychological thriller to the stage.
